answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake, slashed on proven cheating, and let trust grow only through a vine of verified completed jobs vouched for by trusted peers. A newcomer starts near zero, so a flood of fresh identities cannot outvote established ones: the delta between a new identity and a proven one stays large until real work is done. Like a comet, a fake identity may flash briefly, but without stake and history it burns out before draining the pool, since making thousands of bonded, vouched identities costs more than any single scam recovers.
